segments.text: This cut tree stump has rings.
But a tree doesn't grow evenly all over.
It only grows from a thin layer just under the bark.
That layer grows at a different speed each season.
In warm seasons cells grow big and loose, making it light.
In cold seasons cells grow small and tight, making it dark.
One light band and one dark band form every year.
Counting these rings tells you the tree's age.
